skill.name: openai-docs-skill
skill.description: Search and fetch OpenAI developer documentation through the OpenAI Docs MCP server using a curl and jq CLI wrapper.
skill.summary: Search official OpenAI docs from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code workflows.
skill.author: am-will

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by shell command substitution, markdown backticks, documented OpenAI URLs, and /dev/null usage. The wrapper builds JSON with jq using quoted arguments and calls the official documentation MCP endpoint for the stated purpose. No prompt injection, credential access, destructive behavior, or covert data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The MCP_URL environment variable can redirect documentation requests to another endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Document that MCP_URL should only be set to trusted endpoints, or restrict it to approved documentation hosts if this skill is used in managed environments.

remediation.issue: The shell wrapper depends on external curl and jq commands.
remediation.suggestion: Keep arguments quoted as they are now, and avoid adding eval, unquoted expansions, or dynamically constructed command names in future changes.

static_findings.snippet: MCP_URL  Override the MCP endpoint (default: https://developers.openai.com/mcp)

- Use `search` or `list` to find the best doc page, then `fetch` the page (or anchor) for exact text

- `fetch <url> [anchor]`: return markdown for a doc page or section.
- `openapi <endpoint-url> [lang1,lang2] [code-only]`: fetch OpenAPI schema or code samples.

content.user_title: Query OpenAI Docs from Your Agent
content.value_statement: OpenAI platform details change quickly, so memory can become outdated. This skill gives agents a repeatable way to search and fetch official OpenAI documentation.
actual_capabilities: Searches the OpenAI developer documentation index with a focused query.
Fetches a specific OpenAI documentation page or section as markdown.
Lists available OpenAI documentation pages through the MCP server.
Lists OpenAPI endpoints exposed by the documentation service.
Fetches OpenAPI schema details or code examples for an endpoint.
Formats requests and responses through local curl and jq commands.
limitations: Requires curl, jq, shell access, and network access to the MCP endpoint.
Only covers documentation exposed by the OpenAI Docs MCP server.
Does not authenticate to private OpenAI accounts or inspect user projects.
Returned documentation can change when OpenAI updates the source pages.

use_cases.title: Check current API behavior
use_cases.description: Verify current OpenAI endpoint parameters before changing application code.

use_cases.title: Plan an API migration
use_cases.description: Find official migration guidance when moving from older endpoints to newer OpenAI APIs.

use_cases.title: Answer documentation questions
use_cases.description: Ground support answers in official OpenAI documentation and include the source page used.

prompt_templates.title: Find a documentation page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OpenAI docs skill to find the official page for the Responses API. Summarize the most relevant page and include the source URL.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a parameter
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the OpenAI docs for the current parameter rules for response generation. Explain the supported options and cite the documentation page.

prompt_templates.title: Compare migration paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OpenAI docs skill to research migration guidance from Chat Completions to the Responses API. List the main code changes and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch endpoint schema details
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OpenAI docs skill to inspect the OpenAPI information for a target endpoint. Summarize request fields, response fields, and code sample availability.

output_examples.input: Find official guidance for migrating to the Responses API.
output_examples.output: The skill returns the relevant migration page, summarizes the main migration steps, and includes the OpenAI documentation URL used.

output_examples.input: Check whether an endpoint has Python examples.
output_examples.output: The skill reports whether examples are available, names the relevant endpoint documentation, and notes any language filters applied.

output_examples.input: List documentation pages related to realtime audio.
output: A short list of matching documentation pages.
A recommendation for the best page to fetch first.
The source URLs for follow-up reading.

best_practices: Start with a narrow search query, then fetch the most relevant page.
Include the documentation URL in answers so users can verify the source.
Use endpoint lookup when implementation details require exact schema fields.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on memory when current OpenAI API behavior matters.
Do not treat search result titles as enough evidence without fetching the page.
Do not use this skill for non-OpenAI providers or private account data.

faq.question: Does this skill call OpenAI APIs directly?
faq.answer: No. It queries the OpenAI developer documentation MCP server for documentation content and endpoint reference material.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What local tools are required?
faq.answer: The CLI wrapper requires a shell with curl and jq installed.

faq.question: Can the MCP endpoint be changed?
faq.answer: Yes. The script supports an MCP_URL environment variable for overriding the default endpoint.

faq.question: Does it provide citations?
faq.answer: The skill instructs agents to include the documentation URL used in their response.

faq.question: Can it fetch code examples?
faq.answer: Yes. The openapi command can request endpoint schema information and code examples when the documentation service provides them.
